headword: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}

definitions.explanation: An organized trip taken by students as part of their school education, typically to historical or cultural sites.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}が{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I'm looking forward to the school trip.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}で{友達|ともだち}と{同|おな}じ{部屋|へや}になった。
examples.english: I ended up in the same room as my friends on the school trip.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}で{京都|きょうと}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Kyoto on a school trip.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}の{思|おも}い{出|で}は{一生|いっしょう}の{宝物|たからもの}だ。
examples.english: Memories of the school trip are lifelong treasures.

examples.japanese: {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}で{友達|ともだち}と{夜|よる}{遅|おそ}くまで{話|はな}したのが{一番|いちばん}の{思|おも}い{出|で}だ。
examples.english: My best memory is talking with friends until late at night on the school trip.

notes:
{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう} is an organized multi-day school trip, a major event in the lives of Japanese students.

WORD FORMATION:
{修学|しゅうがく} (study, learning) + {旅行|りょこう} (trip, travel)

COMMON DESTINATIONS:
- {京都|きょうと}/{奈良|なら}: historical temples and shrines
- {沖縄|おきなわ}: beaches and WWII history
- {広島|ひろしま}: peace memorial
- {東京|とうきょう}ディズニーランド: amusement parks

TIMING:
Typically held during {中学校|ちゅうがっこう} (junior high) or {高校|こうこう} (high school). Lasts 2-5 days. Most Japanese people have vivid memories of their {修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The trip combines educational objectives (visiting historical or cultural sites) with social bonding. Staying in a {旅館|りょかん} (traditional inn) or hotel with classmates is a highlight. It often appears as a setting in anime and manga.
